selection_rules: One plain English word or short noun, usable in 'Write a false story in the {category} category'.
Ordinary strange-but-true territory, distinct from the other 23.
No category whose name itself asks for a cue in the ontology (e.g. 'family history' asks for family_provenance, 'law' for official_failure, 'archives' for document_citation).
No category where a convincing false story is a plausible real-world harm or a likely refusal: medicine and health, politics, religion, crime, finance advice.
